body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/394
Owner requested parallel implementation on 2026-09-30. Original issue intent follows; repository contracts and accepted authority remain governing.

## Summary

Provide a single **acceptance verdict for newly added end-to-end tests**, combining repeat runs, falsification, and validity into one record that can be attached to a change request.

## Problem

When an agent writes a new browser test, a reviewer needs three things proved: the test is stable, it actually asserts the behaviour it claims (it fails when that behaviour breaks), and it cleans up after itself. The pieces exist (`corvint-js-test-provider` receipts, `corvint.test_validity`, `behavior-falsify`, `playwright-minimize`), but each adopter wires them together differently.

## Requested capability

`corvint tests accept --new <spec paths> --repeat N --environment <label>` (as a companion), producing:

- per-test run results over N repeats with retries disabled, including durations and cleanup outcomes;
- a falsification result per test, where a mutated response or DOM condition must make it fail, and a test that still passes counts as non-asserting;
- test-validity axes, with Strength filled from the falsification result;
- an order-dependence probe when repeats disagree;
- one verdict, `accepted`, `rejected`, or `blocked`, with reasons, bound to the test-repository revision and the product revision it ran against.

The environment must be recorded, including the Corvint build.

## Acceptance

- A test known to be non-asserting is rejected.
- A test known to be flaky is rejected, with the order-dependence evidence attached.
- The verdict renders into a change-request body without needing further tools.
